title: 蒲江斗十四独立规则 v1

summary.deck: 52 ordinary cards plus equal 6/9/12/15 special cards; sevens remain ordinary.
summary.win: Four groups: sum-14 pairs, exposed same-rank triples, or quads; concealed four-pairs is independent.
summary.scoring: Package-backed qia20, jinGouDiao, anDui/dragon, siGuiYi and optional keSuHu only on own flip/replacement.
summary.declaration: Declaration locks the server-computed wait faces.
summary.payments: Exact per-payer 12-place rounding and no duplicate settlement.
